description.content:
The authenticated API Client requests to add a new booking. The client
can refer to existing order lines or create new order lines on the fly.
The booking is created with unique booking number `shippersReference`, `bookingNumber`, `customerCode`
and `supplierCode`. In one single booking, order lines from several different
purchase orders of a single customer can be allocated. After a successful
creation the booking is updated with the booking attributes and the API brings
the booking in the "Booking Requested" state.
Added as a part of security scheme: oauth2
Added as a part of security scheme: oauth2

After finding the existing booking by its `shippersReference` the
authenticated API Client updates the booking. The eSOP configuration
defines the permission for the business party's role to update a booking.

This API is part of the Kuehne+Nagel API layer. It handles bookings
primarily for external partners. To use this API you must be registered and set
up as an API user. Access to the booking API depends on the Task Owner in the customer's
eSOP booking configuration.
